latest_substantive_result.summary: N617 preserves every nonempty reset word while forcing a minimal unit-distance pair MST; on the classical Cerny family the threshold stays quadratic. N618 refutes a stationary expansion and indegree-paid repair even for a strongly connected regular triangle-free digraph. N619 gives separate variable-degree counterexamples to broader weighted claims.
